full_judgment: 3. The defendant No. 3 contested the suit by filing a written statement contending, inter-alia, that Chhakkun Miah was the C.S. recorded tenant and thereafter the suit property was recorded in S.A. khatian in the name of Abdul Halim. It was further case of the defendant that the plaintiffs are neither the heirs of the recorded tenant nor have any interest or possession in the suit land. It was the positive assertion of the defendant that the plaintiffs are fictitious persons. The positive case of the defendant are that Abdul Halim died leaving behind no issue and the suit property vested with the Government as per law.
